summary_en: ¥96.00/share annual dividend (mid-term ¥48.00, year-end ¥48.00) vs. prior ¥93.00 (mid-term ¥45.00, year-end ¥48.00). FY3/27 guidance. Payout ratio target 40–50%. Mid-term earnings raised 18.3% on semiconductor demand and India EV component sales growth. One-time merger accounting gains excluded from dividend cash basis.
title_en: Notice of Revised Consolidated Earnings Forecast for FY3/27 (Upward Revision) and Revised Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: MIRAINI Holdings announced on 29 June 2026 an upward revision to its FY3/27 dividend forecast and consolidated earnings guidance. The annual dividend per share is raised from ¥93.00 (interim ¥45.00 + year-end ¥48.00) to ¥96.00 (interim ¥48.00 + year-end ¥48.00). The mid-term interim dividend is increased by ¥3.00/share to ¥48.00. The company attributes the earnings upgrade to stronger semiconductor memory demand, price increases, and growing demand for EV two-wheeler electronic components in India, raising interim sales 18.3% above prior guidance to ¥272.0 billion. The company targets a payout ratio of 40–50% as its core dividend policy, balancing growth investment, financial soundness, and shareholder returns. A material one-time accounting gain (¥7.0 billion negative goodwill from the recent merger of Satorigumi Denki and Hagihara Denki Holdings in Q1 FY3/27) is explicitly excluded from the cash dividend basis to maintain stable distributions. The full-year earnings guidance reflects the mid-term strength; Q3 onwards remains unchanged from the prior May forecast.
